statement: At least 95% of the women and 95% of the men in ANSUR 1988 (US Army, 1988) can reach every control pressed from its grip without a regrip
rationale: a control out of reach is found in the hand, after the board and the shell have frozen its position; 95% of each sex is the usual human-factors target, and a market with smaller hands sets a higher one

mechanism.how: For each ANSUR 1988 subject, the wrist sits behind each declared grip by the subject's wrist-centre of grip length; a control is in reach when it lies within the subject's wrist-thumbtip (thumb) or wrist-index finger (index finger) length; the share of the worse sex who reach every judged control
